name: What is the process for designing and building an accessible laundry room with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building an accessible laundry room with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs, existing space, and budget. We then conduct an on-site assessment in your Bay Area home to evaluate feasibility and discuss design options. Our team develops a custom plan, incorporating accessible design principles and your preferences. Once the design is approved, we handle all necessary permits, material sourcing, and construction, keeping you informed throughout the project until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, on-site assessment, custom design, permitting, material sourcing, and construction in your Bay Area home.
